raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to adapt the strategy when technical obstacles resulting from repeated WebSurfer timeouts occurred. By excessively relying on WebSurfer to extract authoritative details (IMDb, Wikipedia) instead of pivoting to alternative sources or error-resilient approaches (e.g., using FileSurfer to process a local copy of IMDb movie metadata or switching agents to Coder to build auxiliary tools for data extraction), the conversation cascaded into repetitive failures. This repeated reliance despite clear evidence of consistent WebSurfer errors indicates a lack of contingency planning and proactive decision-making to resolve the task.
